m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: <ITALICS>As soon as you focus on the Zealous Colossus you feel a surge of power from your heart go into it. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>There's a deep rumble of repeating thunder, the pulse of the land, that echoes through your being. </ITALICS>
Spellbinder! I am... most pleased to see your smooth face again. :Tsssk: You have done what none thought truly possible.
You have given us freedom, and hope, and mercy. Thank you.
We heard the storm of your battle with the Shadow Queen, Spellbinder! What a sign of victory!
Truly, truly amazing! You have restored the land, and inspired us to reach across the sea and treat with the Burrowers!
I can assure you that many, many hatchlings will now bear your name!
<ITALICS>As with the Zealous Colossus, the Rubicund Colossus immediately springs to life upon your presence. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>A sense of warmth and peace fills every fiber of your being. You should tell Zaltanna. </ITALICS>
Zaltanna is too reserved! You are a hero to us all! The Light is restored, the Shadow driven out, and all our days will be joyous ones!
Wizard, it is so good to see you hale and hearty. I must tell you we were all concerned for your safety.
Now, tell me what happened. Do not spare any details.
Morganthe is gone. I understand, there was no other way. We must learn all we can from her story, so future tragedies may be averted.
This news of Old Cob is troubling, but we shall just have to wait and see what tomorrow brings. New adventures for us all, yes?
You have absorbed a great deal of Morganthe's stolen power. Too much, in fact. Should you not shed it, it would consume you.
Luckily, the answer is simple. Give it back to the land. Go to Zha-Te-:Ke:-Zang-Zeeyun and restore the Zealous Colossus.
Then return to Bastion and revitalize the Rubicund Colossus. I will watch for you there.
Restore the Zealous Colossus in the City of Sardonyx, and the Rubicund Colossus in Bastion. I will be watching.
